title: Chapter 574
text:
In the machinery modification room …

"Core module installed. Self-check in progress, hum … Self-check complete. Everything is in good condition. Starting assembly of auxiliary modules, hum …"

More than ten mechanical cantilevers quickly assembled the components of the new mechanical suit, and virtual screens displayed the various parameters and functions of the mechanical suit.

Philip acted as an AI assistant in the manufacturing process, coordinating the entire process with his super high computing speed. When he discovered the minor problems between the various components, Han Xiao would constantly make adjustments to improve the quality of the finished product.

Purple grade and above were the rarest quality. The higher the grade of the machinery, the harder it was to improve the quality. However, problems that could be solved with money were not problems at all.

The core materials of the new mechanical suit cost more than 100,000 Enas, and he had even integrated the Void Dragon Bone into it. With so many rare materials, it was very easy to improve the quality. For equipment of the same type and level, the attributes of pink equipment were much higher than purple equipment.

Now that he had entered the Calamity Grade, his Mechanical Force was abundant, and he had extremely high Machinery Affinity. With all kinds of talents and skills, Han Xiao's manufacturing efficiency was extremely fast. Even building a high-level mechanical suit did not take too long.

Chi!

The mechanical cantilevers connected the various mechanical suit modules. After the assembly was completed, the cantilevers spat out a gas with cooling and optimization effects. This was the final step.

The cold white gas spread out in all directions, and a black and gold mechanical suit stood in front of Han Xiao, reflecting a metallic luster.

Han Xiao's fingers exploded with electric sparks, and he pressed on the chest of the mechanical suit, releasing a trace of Mechanical Force to activate the mechanical suit.

In an instant, the surface of the mech seemed to ripple. Countless black nanomachines started to roll. Only then did the armor module appear on the seemingly thin mech. The armor was like pieces of strong muscles. It had a very noble aura. The black and gold lines were very flashy.

He used [Super Nano Power] on the new mechanical suit. There were many nanoparticles stored inside the mechanical suit, and they had the memory alloy attribute. The various weapon modules were set up in advance, and it could transform at any time. Although the design looked simple, the entire body was a weapon, and its functions were very complicated.

Other than that, the nanoparticles could also repair itself and provide energy.

"This mechanical suit is much stronger than the Void Dragon. It's the strongest machine I've ever built …"

Han Xiao opened the interface and looked at the mechanical suit's attributes.

—

Berserk Ape

Type: Super Nano Transformative Mechanical Suit

Grade: Pink

Equipment Requirements: LV 135, Mechanic, more than 10000 Energy

Basic Stats: Armor: 86000/86000, Defense: 0, Power Rank: 3,400, Energy: 27500

Height: 1.96 m

Weight: 260 lb

Control Method: Intermediate Artificial Intelligence Assistance + Nerve Link (+ 10% attribute bonus)

Energy: Mini Highly Enriched Nuclear Reactor – Automatic Recharge. Normal Mode Energy Recovery: 480/min. If Energy is used as fuel, 40/s Energy Recovery: 90/s

Standby Mode Consumption: 45 Energy/min

Combat Mode Energy Consumption: 110 Energy/Minute

Core Power: 2,375/2,700

Skeleton Module: PR-909 Super Nano Polymeric Fiber (Dark Purple) + Nano Particle Matrix. Provides super high power output. Can greatly convert energy to enhance mechanical suit performance. + 125 STR, + 131 DEX, 350 power consumption. Nanoparticles can be activated to increase performance. Energy consumption: 50/minute. Attribute bonus: + 45%.

Armor Module: Kyle Alloy (Dark Purple) + Void Dragon Bone (Powder) + Refined Overga Metal (Purple)

Weapon Module: Nano Particle Transformation Weapon List [Collapse/Expand]. Power consumption: 725

Propulsion Module: Anti-gravity Electromagnetic Acceleration + Basic Galactic Engine. Power consumption: 500

…

Ability: Nano Repair. Nano Particles have the memory attribute, so the mechanical suit will repair itself. Energy consumption: 200/minute. Recovers 5% Armor Value/minute. Recovers double after leaving combat.

Throwing will cause the first stage of damage, and landing will cause the last stage of damage. Every time the target hits an obstacle, a new round of damage will occur. The damage loss will depend on the size and toughness of the obstacle. If the target hits another target, the target will be hit. Energy consumption: 60/minute. Cooldown: 16s.

Special Ability: Nano Transformation (Three Forms).

Voyage Form: Transforms into a shuttle form. Unable to use melee attacks. In this form, flight speed is greatly increased. Able to perform interstellar travel.

Remarks: Supers who are not strong enough will be committing suicide by wearing this mechanical suit.

—

Compared to the previous mecha, the biggest difference was the type of equipment. In the past, the snake and dragon series mechas were "single-soldier light mechas", while the Berserk Ape was a "super-nano shape-shifting mecha", which had the ability to change its form and did not require any components.

Speaking of which, many Ape series mechanical suits were transformation mechanical suits. Could this series have originated from the Saiyan Monkeys that could transform?

The combat power of the new mechanical suit was very strong and had basically met Han Xiao's requirements. The mechanical suit was finally tougher than the body, and its damage output was very high. Furthermore, it was equipped with an interstellar travel engine, which was equivalent to a single soldier aircraft. It could attack battleships on its own in interstellar battles.

After turning the Berserk Ape into a compressed orb, Han Xiao wore it around his neck. He could not help but feel a little itchy. He wanted to find someone to spar with and test the combat power of the new mechanical suit.

However, after thinking about it, his own officers could only be beaten up by him. It would not be convenient to find other Army Commanders or Godora experts.

"The celebration is about to begin. It's better not to cause trouble. There will be plenty of opportunities in the future."

Han Xiao temporarily put away this thought. The new mechanical suit was only one part of the upgrade of his combat equipment. There were still various new weapons and mechanical soldiers that he had to build. When he formed the Mech Legion again, he would then reach the limit of his current combat power.

…

The date of the celebration was set.

Before it was held, Godora officials revealed the news of the destruction of Dark-star, which shook the entire Star System.

Dark-star was famous in the Shattered Star Ring, and it was actually destroyed. This was earth-shattering news!

Countless galactic residents were stunned. Godora and Dark-star had been in a stalemate for many years. No one had expected the infamous Dark-star to be destroyed without any warning. It was too sudden.

Many organizations were still guessing how the storm caused by Dark-star would end, and they could not help but be dumbfounded.

Godora officials only released a brief report. They would only announce the process of destroying Dark-star during the celebration, which was equivalent to a press conference. Therefore, the entire Shattered Star Ring's citizens were extremely focused on the upcoming celebration of Godora.

Countless galactic reporters were like sharks that smelled blood. They swarmed to Godora's mother planet and eagerly waited for the celebration to begin.

The various galactic channels had reached an agreement with Godora and would broadcast the entire process of the celebration.

As the date of the celebration approached, countless galactic residents were looking forward to Godora announcing the process of the celebration. They were looking forward to how Dark-star was destroyed!

Amidst the anticipation of everyone, the day of the celebration finally arrived.

—
